The thickness of the strip produced by the hot rolling method is larger, cold rolling...

common:generalComment.#text: A rivet is a mechanical fastener that consists of a smooth cylindrical shaft with a head on one end. Upon installation, the tail is deformed to hold the rivet in place, resulting in a permanent fixing. Rivets are commonly used in aircraft, bridges, structures, and various manufacturing industries. Their technical aspects include material composition, diameter, length, head type, and mechanical properties. They may comply with specific industry standards and be subject to quality control measures. Usage information often indicates which materials or structures they are intended to join. There is no specific ‘production route’ as rivets can be made from various metals or non-metallic materials depending on their application, and there is no single ‘educt name’ or production mix associated with rivets. They are available in a wide variety of sizes and materials for different uses, either to consumer or at plant.

铆钉是一种机械紧固件，它包括一个平滑的圆柱形轴和一个端部的头。安装时，尾部变形以保持铆钉到位，从而形成永久性固定。铆钉通常用于飞机、桥梁、结构和各种制造行业。其技术方面包括材料成分、直径、长度、头部类型和机械属性。它们可能符合特定行业标准，并接受质量控制措施。使用信息通常指出它们打算连接哪些材料或结构。由于铆钉可以根据其应用从不同的金属或非金属材料制成，因此没有特定的‘生产路线’，也没有与铆钉相关联的单一‘原料名称’或生产混合物。它们以多种尺寸和材料可供不同用途使用，无论是向消费者还是在工厂。

common:generalComment.#text: Deionised water is water that has had its ions removed. It is produced through a process that filters out minerals and ions such as calcium, sodium, iron, copper, chloride, and bromide. It has no set standard compliance but is often produced to meet specific quality criteria required for certain industrial or laboratory processes. Deionised water is typically used in applications where the presence of ions may interfere with machinery, experiments, or manufacturing processes, such as in cooling applications, laboratory tests, or electronics manufacturing. The production route involves ion exchange, reverse osmosis, or distillation. The product may be supplied as part of a production or consumption mix and is available at the production plant or to the consumer.
去离子水是通过去除了其离子的水。它通过过滤掉矿物质及离子如钙、钠、铁、铜、氯化物和溴化物的过程产生。它没有设定的标准遵从性，但通常生产出来以满足某些工业或实验室过程所需的特定质量标准。去离子水通常应用于离子存在可能干扰机械、实验或制造过程的地方，例如在冷却应用、实验室测试或电子制造中。其生产路线包括离子交换、反渗透或蒸馏。该产品可能作为生产或消费混合物供应，且可在生产工厂或消费者那里获得。
